research_question: What is the effect of statins compared with placebo on deep vein thrombosis (DVT), stratified by type of statin (rosuvastatin, atorvastatin, pravastatin), for the primary prevention of venous thromboembolism?
outcome_description: Incidence of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) reported as number of events per randomized arm.
positive_direction: A positive effect / lower odds of DVT indicates a beneficial reduction in deep vein thrombosis events favoring statin therapy over placebo.
search_queries: statin placebo deep vein thrombosis randomized trial
rosuvastatin atorvastatin pravastatin venous thromboembolism controlled trial
statin DVT incidence randomized placebo controlled trial
inclusion_criteria: Randomized controlled trials comparing statin therapy (such as rosuvastatin, atorvastatin, or pravastatin) to placebo.
Conducted in adult populations evaluated for cardiovascular or venous thromboembolic primary prevention.
Reports quantitative event data on deep vein thrombosis (DVT) or venous thromboembolism allowing computation of odds ratios.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, and protocols are excluded).
No placebo control group (e.g., head-to-head statin comparisons or open-label studies without a placebo arm).
No extractable quantitative outcome data for deep vein thrombosis (e.g., missing event counts and sample sizes per arm).
Completely unrelated to statin therapy or venous thromboembolism outcomes.
moderators_to_extract: Statin dosage and intensity (low, moderate, high intensity)
Baseline participant risk profile / clinical indication
Mean age and sex distribution of participants
effect_size_note: Dichotomous event data (DVT events and total participants per arm) will be pooled as Odds Ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals, analyzed and presented stratified by statin type (rosuvastatin, atorvastatin, pravastatin).
